top_signals.title: Some migrants ready to pack bags fearing far-right win in east German state
top_signals.summary: The anti-immigration, Islamophobic and Russia-friendly AfD party is poised to win in the state of Saxony-Anhalt, with hopes of taking its first-ever governing majority.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
